en.text: BERM proposes that a physical field input can alter membrane dynamics through an endpoint-specific response kernel, after which voltage-gated calcium-channel opening can increase intracellular Ca²⁺ and activate mitochondrial ROS production. FieldState may measure the physical input but does not supply this biological operator.

fi.text: BERM ehdottaa, että fysikaalinen kenttäsyöte voi muuttaa kalvodynamiikkaa päätepistekohtaisen vasteytimen kautta, minkä jälkeen jänniteherkkien kalsiumkanavien avautuminen voi nostaa solunsisäistä Ca²⁺-pitoisuutta ja aktivoida mitokondriaalisen ROS-tuotannon. FieldState voi mitata fysikaalisen syötteen mutta ei tuota tätä biologista operaattoria.

supports: VGCC activation is a primary transduction mechanism for RF and ELF fields
does_not_support: VGCC activation is the only transduction mechanism

claims.falsification_condition: Selective VGCC blockade eliminates ROS increase in field-exposed cells across three independent labs

en.text: Cryptochrome proteins form radical pairs whose spin dynamics are modulated by the ambient magnetic field vector, altering downstream clock gene expression and redox state.

fi.text: Kryptokromiproteiinit muodostavat radikaalipareja, joiden spin-dynamiikkaa moduloi ympäröivän magneettikentän vektori, muuttaen alajuoksun kellogeenien ilmentymistä ja redox-tilaa.

supports: Radical-pair mechanism provides a quantum-coherent transduction pathway
does_not_support: RPM is sufficient to explain all observed biological effects of magnetic fields

claims.falsification_condition: CRY-knockout organisms show identical circadian and redox responses to magnetic field changes as wild-type

en.text: Field-induced suppression of pineal melatonin synthesis disrupts circadian redox cycling, reducing antioxidant capacity in reproductive tissues and altering HPG axis timing.

fi.text: Kentän aiheuttama käpylisäkkeen melatoniinisynteesin suppressio häiritsee sirkadiaanista redox-syklitystä, vähentäen antioksidanttikapasiteettia lisääntymiskudoksissa ja muuttaen HPG-akselin ajoitusta.

supports: Melatonin pathway mediates circadian disruption effects on reproduction
does_not_support: Melatonin is the sole mediator of field effects on fertility

claims.falsification_condition: Exogenous melatonin replacement fully restores reproductive function in field-exposed animals

en.text: BERM registers ROS damage, BTB disruption and impaired steroidogenesis as converging candidate explanations for changes in sperm count, motility and DNA integrity. Connecting any FieldState record to those endpoints requires an independently calibrated L2 exposure-to-response mapping.

fi.text: BERM rekisteröi ROS-vaurion, BTB-häiriön ja heikentyneen steroidogeneesin ehdokkaiksi, jotka voivat yhdessä selittää siittiömäärän, liikkuvuuden ja DNA-eheyden muutoksia. FieldState-tietueen kytkeminen näihin päätepisteisiin vaatii erikseen kalibroidun L2-altistus–vaste-kuvauksen.

supports: BERM can test multiple converging candidate mechanisms against separate male-fertility endpoints
does_not_support: Sperm decline alone explains the full fertility drop

claims.falsification_condition: Pre-registered endpoint-specific studies fail to support the proposed pathway after BERM's L2 mapping from FieldState-compatible physical measurements to response has been independently specified and calibrated

en.text: Couple-level fecundability declines as a multiplicative product of independently impaired male output (sperm parameters), female ovulatory timing (clock disruption), and implantation support (luteal/placental integrity).

fi.text: Paritason hedelmällisyys heikkenee itsenäisesti heikentyneen miestuotannon (siittiöparametrit), naisen ovulaation ajoituksen (kellohäiriö) ja implantaatiotuen (luteaalisen/istukkaan eheyden) multiplikatiivisena tulona.

supports: The couple-level model integrates male and female components
does_not_support: All fertility decline is biologically mediated — demand, tempo, and ART are separate inputs

claims.falsification_condition: A prospective cohort with FieldState-compatible physical measurements shows no association between the preregistered BERM exposure estimate and time-to-pregnancy after controlling for behavioral factors

en.text: BERM v17 uses a two-channel technology-timing proxy whose χ shape matches the normalized rank-one inverse-metric coordinate χ_geo. Its proxy weighting is not a FieldState measurement, an optimized biological coupling, or a Lindgren-derived tissue response.

fi.text: BERM v17 käyttää kaksikanavaista teknologia-ajoitusproxyä, jonka χ-muoto vastaa normalisoitua käänteisen rank-one-metriikan koordinaattia χ_geo. Sen proxypainotus ei ole FieldState-mittaus, optimoitu biologinen kytkentä eikä Lindgrenistä johdettu kudosvaste.

supports: The proxy provides a reproducible timing input for the archived BERM v17 comparison route
does_not_support: The proxy measures FieldState, identifies a biological coupling mode, or calibrates the conditional L2 response kernel

claims.falsification_condition: The pre-specified two-channel timing proxy fails its registered out-of-sample BERM v17 comparisons or is outperformed by pre-registered alternatives across independent datasets

en.text: For the 2025 ansatz g = η + κA⊗A and an explicitly normalized positive-norm mode ρ² = κA², the rank-one inverse metric contains the bounded coefficient ρ²/(1+ρ²); defining χ_geo = ρ/√(1+ρ²) is therefore a derived geometric coordinate, not a biological susceptibility.

fi.text: Vuoden 2025 ansatzille g = η + κA⊗A ja eksplisiittisesti normalisoidulle positiivinormiselle moodille ρ² = κA² käänteinen rank-one-metriikka sisältää rajatun kertoimen ρ²/(1+ρ²); määritelmä χ_geo = ρ/√(1+ρ²) on siten johdettu geometrinen koordinaatti, ei biologinen herkkyys.

supports: A dimensionless bounded geometry coordinate after the stated norm and normalization choices
does_not_support: A universal tissue gain, dose-response curve, membrane field scale or receptor effect

claims.falsification_condition: The rank-one inverse identity or the stated normalization is algebraically invalid for the selected positive-norm mode.

en.text: The exact BERM decomposition δg = κ(Ā⊗a + a⊗Ā + a⊗a) contains a quadratic self-term. For an amplitude-modulated carrier or two tones, that term algebraically generates DC, envelope and difference-frequency components before any biological mechanism is assumed.

fi.text: Tarkka BERM-hajotelma δg = κ(Ā⊗a + a⊗Ā + a⊗a) sisältää neliöllisen itseistermin. Amplitudimoduloidulle kantoaallolle tai kahdelle taajuudelle tämä termi synnyttää algebrallisesti DC-, verhokäyrä- ja erotustaajuuskomponentit ennen biologisen mekanismin olettamista.

supports: A theory-internal route by which high-frequency waveforms can contain low-frequency metric-drive components
does_not_support: That the generated term is large enough to affect a tissue or that a tissue detects it

claims.falsification_condition: The stated waveform expansion fails to produce the registered DC, envelope and difference-frequency coefficients.

en.text: Conditional on minimal matter–metric coupling and response theory, BERM maps the Lindgren metric perturbation to an observable with δ⟨O_i⟩ = ∫Ξ_i^{μν}δg_{μν} + higher-order response. This derives the operator form but not its tissue kernel Ξ_i, physical scale, gauge prescription or human endpoint coefficient.

fi.text: Ehdolla, että materia kytkeytyy metriikkaan minimaalisesti ja vastefunktioteoria pätee, BERM kuvaa Lindgrenin metriikkahäiriön havaittavaan suureeseen muodossa δ⟨O_i⟩ = ∫Ξ_i^{μν}δg_{μν} + korkeamman kertaluvun vaste. Tämä johtaa operaattorin muodon mutta ei kudosydintä Ξ_i, fysikaalista mittakaavaa, gauge-reseptiä tai ihmispäätepisteen kerrointa.

supports: A conditional, falsifiable geometry-to-observable response architecture
does_not_support: A calibrated causal effect of an environmental field on any human endpoint

claims.falsification_condition: A registered tissue observable cannot be represented by linear or higher-order causal response kernels under the stated matter-coupling premises.

en.text: Total testosterone does not uniquely determine tissue androgen exposure: SHBG and albumin binding transform total concentration into a free or bioavailable fraction, while intratesticular concentration is a separate compartment. BERM therefore keeps production and availability as separate state variables.

fi.text: Kokonais-testosteroni ei yksikäsitteisesti määrää kudoksen androgeenialtistusta: SHBG- ja albumiinisitoutuminen muuntavat kokonaispitoisuuden vapaaksi tai biologisesti saatavaksi osuudeksi, ja intratestikulaarinen pitoisuus on erillinen kompartimentti. BERM pitää siksi tuotannon ja saatavuuden erillisinä tilamuuttujina.

supports: Free testosterone, SHBG, albumin and compartment-specific androgen measurements alongside total testosterone
does_not_support: That EMF changes SHBG or free testosterone in humans

claims.falsification_condition: Matched measurements show that total testosterone alone predicts every tissue androgen endpoint with no added information from binding or compartment state.

en.text: Androgen action is a serial capacity chain: free or intratesticular ligand availability × receptor occupancy and abundance (classical AR and tissue-specific membrane routes such as ZIP9) × post-receptor transmission. Thus hormone-use capacity can fall without a proportional fall in measured total testosterone.

fi.text: Androgeenivaikutus on sarjallinen kapasiteettiketju: vapaan tai intratestikulaarisen ligandin saatavuus × reseptorimiehitys ja -määrä (klassinen AR sekä kudoskohtaiset kalvoreitit kuten ZIP9) × reseptorin jälkeinen välitys. Siksi hormoninkäyttökapasiteetti voi laskea ilman suhteellista laskua mitatussa kokonais-testosteronissa.

supports: An androgen-effective-capacity state with separately observable ligand, AR, ZIP9 and downstream components
does_not_support: A universal EMF-to-AR coefficient or extrapolation of one rat RF protocol to human population effects

claims.falsification_condition: Prospective receptor-level measurements show unchanged tissue response whenever total testosterone is unchanged, across altered binding, receptor abundance and post-receptor states.

en.text: TFR is a derived sum of age-specific fertility rates (ASFR), each of which receives inputs from biological fecundability, demand/opportunity, tempo effects, and ART delivery — TFR decline cannot be attributed to any single input without decomposition.

fi.text: TFR on johdettu summa ikäkohtaisista hedelmällisyysluvuista (ASFR), joista kukin saa panoksia biologisesta hedelmällisyydestä, kysynnästä/mahdollisuudesta, tempoefekteistä ja avusteisesta lisääntymisestä — TFR:n laskua ei voi attribuoida yksittäiseen panokseen ilman dekompositiota.

supports: Proper attribution requires separating biological from behavioral and medical inputs
does_not_support: All TFR decline is FieldState-driven

en.text: The biological response to an applied field depends on the vector state of the ambient background: relative angle, polarity and static background magnitude at the exposed tissue determine which field components couple, so exposure is recorded as a vector-and-background pair rather than a scalar intensity.

fi.text: Biologinen vaste kentälle riippuu ympäröivän taustan vektoritilasta: suhteellinen kulma, polariteetti ja staattisen taustan suuruus altistuvassa kudoksessa määräävät, mitkä kenttäkomponentit kytkeytyvät, joten altistus kirjataan vektorin ja taustan parina eikä skalaarisena intensiteettinä.

supports: Exposure assessment must record background geometry alongside applied field magnitude
does_not_support: Any single vector configuration transfers to human organ-level dose

claims.falsification_condition: Exposure–response for reproductive endpoints is reproduced by scalar intensity alone, with no residual dependence on background vector or orientation, in three independent laboratories.

en.text: The modulation envelope of an exposure sets the biological response independently of carrier intensity: mitochondrial potential and ROS output vary with envelope frequency across the sub-hertz and ELF range.

fi.text: Altistuksen modulaatioverhokäyrä määrää biologisen vasteen kantoaallon intensiteetistä riippumatta: mitokondrion potentiaali ja ROS-tuotto vaihtelevat verhokäyrän taajuuden mukaan alle hertsin ja ELF-alueella.

supports: Envelope and beat structure are measured field-state features, not incidental signal properties
does_not_support: The envelope response measured in cell lines transfers to a reproductive endpoint

claims.falsification_condition: Mitochondrial potential and ROS responses are flat across envelope frequency at matched field intensity in three independent cell systems.

en.text: The triboelectric material–skin interface is a measurable field-state variable: charge magnitude and decay time depend on textile material and antistatic treatment, and prolonged interface configurations carry organism-level consequences in human and arthropod systems.

fi.text: Triboelektrinen materiaali–iho-rajapinta on mitattava kenttätilan muuttuja: varauksen suuruus ja purkautumisaika riippuvat tekstiilimateriaalista ja antistaattikäsittelystä, ja pitkäkestoiset rajapintakonfiguraatiot tuottavat eliötason seurauksia ihmisellä ja niveljalkaisilla.

supports: Material and treatment belong in the measured field state at the skin interface
does_not_support: Historical V/cm² readings convert into charge, V/m or an organ-level field

claims.falsification_condition: Charge magnitude and relaxation time are identical across textile materials and antistatic treatments under controlled humidity, and prolonged interface changes produce no reproductive or behavioural difference.

en.text: Low-frequency electric fields act as a distinct exposure channel with polarity-specific effects: AC and positive DC treatments change organism behaviour where negative DC of the same magnitude does not, so waveform and polarity belong to the measured field state.

fi.text: Matalataajuiset sähkökentät toimivat omana altistuskanavanaan polariteettikohtaisin vaikutuksin: AC- ja positiivinen DC-käsittely muuttavat eliön käyttäytymistä, kun samansuuruinen negatiivinen DC ei muuta, joten aaltomuoto ja polariteetti kuuluvat mitattuun kenttätilaan.

supports: AC/DC electric-field components are recorded separately from RF and magnetic channels
does_not_support: Pollinator and mite behaviour results transfer to human exposure or to RF hypotheses

claims.falsification_condition: Behavioural responses are identical for AC, positive DC and negative DC treatments at matched field magnitude in paired field experiments.

en.text: Field exposure shifts membrane potential and the Ca²⁺/AMPK/mTOR growth signalling that reads it, and this bioelectric setpoint governs gonadal reserve rather than an acute output measure.

fi.text: Kenttäaltistus siirtää kalvopotentiaalia ja sitä lukevaa Ca²⁺/AMPK/mTOR-kasvusignalointia, ja tämä biosähköinen asetuspiste ohjaa sukurauhasten reserviä eikä akuuttia tuotosmittaria.

supports: A bioelectric setpoint mediates between field exposure and reserve-level reproductive state
does_not_support: A quantitative human mTOR-pathway dose-response

claims.falsification_condition: Membrane-potential and mTOR-pathway readouts are unchanged across exposure conditions that alter follicular or spermatogonial reserve.

en.text: Exposure during gestational and early postnatal development sets a persistent reproductive state: offspring exposed in utero show altered follicle counts and ovarian morphology at maturity, so the developmental window carries exposure forward instead of resolving it.

fi.text: Altistus raskauden ja varhaisen syntymänjälkeisen kehityksen aikana asettaa pysyvän lisääntymistilan: kohdussa altistuneilla jälkeläisillä on kypsyysiässä muuttuneet follikkelimäärät ja munasarjan morfologia, joten kehitysikkuna kantaa altistuksen eteenpäin sen sijaan että se palautuisi.

supports: Exposure timing relative to development is a separate variable from exposure magnitude
does_not_support: A human developmental exposure-response or reserve-decline estimate

claims.falsification_condition: Developmental exposure produces no difference in adult follicle counts or germline reserve relative to sham controls in three independent cohorts.

en.text: The circadian and HPA state gates HPG steroidogenic output: exposure timed to different points of the daily cycle produces different melatonin and antioxidant rhythm outcomes, and clock disruption in steroidogenic cells removes progesterone support downstream.

fi.text: Vuorokausirytmi- ja HPA-tila portittaa HPG-akselin steroidogeenisen tuoton: eri vuorokaudenaikoihin ajoitettu altistus tuottaa erilaiset melatoniini- ja antioksidanttirytmit, ja kellon häiriö steroidogeenisissä soluissa poistaa progesteronituen alavirrasta.

supports: Exposure timing is part of the dose for endocrine endpoints
does_not_support: A human conception-rate or birth-rate effect size

claims.falsification_condition: Exposure timing across the daily cycle produces identical hormone and antioxidant rhythms, and clock-gene disruption in steroidogenic cells leaves progesterone support intact.

en.text: The blood-brain barrier is a redox-controlled state: oxidative load raises permeability and relocalizes occludin, and antioxidant treatment attenuates the change, so barrier integrity is a variable in the model rather than a fixed anatomical constant.

fi.text: Veri-aivoeste on redox-säädelty tila: hapetuskuorma nostaa läpäisevyyttä ja siirtää okludiinin sijaintia, ja antioksidanttihoito vaimentaa muutoksen, joten esteen eheys on mallin muuttuja eikä kiinteä anatominen vakio.

supports: Barrier permeability is modelled as a redox-dependent modulator
does_not_support: Direct EMF-to-BBB evidence — the upstream manipulation in the bounded record is not EMF

claims.falsification_condition: Controlled oxidative load leaves blood-brain barrier permeability and tight-junction protein localization unchanged.

en.text: The blood-testis barrier is the redox-sensitive gate on spermatogenesis: oxidative load lowers junction proteins and degrades sperm endpoints, and localized RF exposure produces delayed sperm changes through a Spock3–MMP2 barrier axis.

fi.text: Veri-kiveseste on spermatogeneesin redox-herkkä portti: hapetuskuorma vähentää liitosproteiineja ja heikentää siittiöiden päätepisteitä, ja paikallinen RF-altistus tuottaa viivästyneitä siittiömuutoksia Spock3–MMP2-esteakselin kautta.

supports: Barrier state mediates between redox load and sperm endpoints
does_not_support: Human transfer of the rat local-exposure protocol or a calibrated barrier coefficient

claims.falsification_condition: Junction proteins and sperm endpoints are unchanged under controlled oxidative load and under localized RF exposure with a barrier-pathway rescue arm.

en.text: Localized exposure reaches the Sertoli and germline reserve, not only the mature sperm population: reproductive changes appear on a delay consistent with damage to the reserve that supplies later spermatogenic cycles.

fi.text: Paikallinen altistus tavoittaa Sertolin solujen ja itulinjan reservin eikä vain kypsää siittiöpopulaatiota: lisääntymismuutokset ilmenevät viiveellä, joka vastaa vauriota reservissä, joka syöttää myöhemmät spermatogeneesikierrot.

supports: Reserve-level damage is modelled separately from acute sperm-parameter change
does_not_support: A human recovery-time constant for the germline reserve

claims.falsification_condition: Sperm parameters recover completely within one spermatogenic cycle after exposure ends, with no reserve-level deficit in the exposed animals.

en.text: Leydig steroidogenic output is an affected endpoint distinct from sperm production: exposure protocols change testosterone alongside redox and sperm measures, and pooled rodent evidence lists hormone endpoints as a recurring outcome class.

fi.text: Leydigin solujen steroidogeeninen tuotto on siittiötuotannosta erillinen vaikuttunut päätepiste: altistusprotokollat muuttavat testosteronia redox- ja siittiömittausten ohella, ja koottu jyrsijänäyttö listaa hormonipäätepisteet toistuvana tulosluokkana.

supports: Steroidogenic output is tracked as its own endpoint in the male branch
does_not_support: A single biological coefficient from the pooled rodent literature

claims.falsification_condition: Pooled exposure studies show no hormone-endpoint shift once dosimetry and thermal-control heterogeneity are accounted for.

en.text: Ovarian reserve is set by exposure history rather than by concurrent exposure: prenatal and early postnatal protocols reduce primordial and secondary follicle counts and raise atresia measured at maturity.

fi.text: Munasarjareservi määräytyy altistushistorian eikä samanaikaisen altistuksen mukaan: raskaudenaikaiset ja varhaiset syntymänjälkeiset protokollat vähentävät primordiaali- ja sekundaarifollikkelien määrää ja lisäävät atresiaa kypsyysiässä mitattuna.

supports: Reserve is a stock variable carrying earlier exposure, separate from acute ovulatory function
does_not_support: A human AMH/AFC reserve-decline calibration

claims.falsification_condition: Follicle counts and atresia at maturity are independent of developmental exposure across three independent replications.

en.text: Oocyte competence tracks mitochondrial redox state: melatonin and antioxidant manipulation change oxidative-damage markers and embryo-development measures, and exposure protocols that shift circadian redox also shift oocyte and follicular measures.

fi.text: Munasolun kelpoisuus seuraa mitokondrion redox-tilaa: melatoniini- ja antioksidanttikäsittely muuttavat hapetusvauriomerkkejä ja alkionkehityksen mittareita, ja vuorokausirytmin redox-tilaa siirtävät altistusprotokollat siirtävät myös munasolu- ja follikkelimittareita.

supports: Oocyte quality is modelled as a redox-resilience state, not only as an age variable
does_not_support: A human IVF outcome prediction

claims.falsification_condition: Oocyte redox markers and embryo-development measures are unchanged by melatonin and antioxidant manipulation and by circadian-disrupting exposure.

en.text: Ovulatory and steroidogenic timing is clock-gated inside the ovary: disrupting the clock in ovarian steroidogenic cells alone impairs progesterone support, so the timing gate is local and not only hypothalamic.

fi.text: Ovulaation ja steroidogeneesin ajoitus on kellon portittama munasarjan sisällä: pelkkien munasarjan steroidogeenisten solujen kellon häirintä heikentää progesteronitukea, joten ajoitusportti on paikallinen eikä vain hypotalaminen.

supports: A local ovarian clock is an independent timing input to fecundability
does_not_support: An EMF-to-clock-gene effect size — the bounded record uses genetic disruption

claims.falsification_condition: Cell-specific ovarian clock disruption leaves ovulatory timing and luteal steroid output intact.

en.text: Implantation depends on luteal and redox support generated upstream of the uterus: ovarian clock disruption impairs progesterone support and implantation, and oocyte redox manipulation changes embryo-development outcomes.

fi.text: Implantaatio riippuu kohdun yläpuolella syntyvästä luteaali- ja redox-tuesta: munasarjakellon häiriö heikentää progesteronitukea ja implantaatiota, ja munasolun redox-käsittely muuttaa alkionkehityksen tuloksia.

supports: Conception-to-live-birth support is a separate model stage from conception itself
does_not_support: A population miscarriage or live-birth rate estimate

claims.falsification_condition: Progesterone support and implantation rates are unchanged by ovarian clock disruption and by oocyte redox manipulation.

en.text: Field state governs species encounter and dispersal before any fitness effect: arthropods cross air gaps to charged hosts, change floral landings under weak AC and DC fields, initiate ballooning in atmospheric fields, and shift synganglion neuropeptide transcripts under RF exposure.

fi.text: Kenttätila ohjaa lajien kohtaamista ja leviämistä ennen mitään kelpoisuusvaikutusta: niveljalkaiset ylittävät ilmarakoja varautuneisiin isäntiin, muuttavat kukkiin laskeutumista heikoissa AC- ja DC-kentissä, aloittavat lentolähdön ilmakehän kentissä ja muuttavat synganglionin neuropeptidilähettejä RF-altistuksessa.

supports: Encounter and dispersal are modelled as field-dependent steps in the ecological branch
does_not_support: A population-abundance, colony-fitness or selection estimate

claims.falsification_condition: Attachment, landing, dispersal and synganglion transcript measures are independent of field configuration across the tested species.

en.text: Age-specific fertility carries a cohort signature: country-level ASFR series contrasted against technology-adoption timing show an age and cohort pattern consistent with the developmental-memory premise, measured as a descriptive contrast rather than an exposure-response.

fi.text: Ikäkohtainen hedelmällisyys kantaa kohorttijäljen: maatason ASFR-sarjat teknologian käyttöönoton ajoitusta vasten verrattuina näyttävät ikä- ja kohorttikuvion, joka vastaa kehityksellisen muistin premissiä, mitattuna kuvailevana kontrastina eikä altistus-vastesuhteena.

supports: The age/cohort contrast is a testable predicted signature of the developmental premise
does_not_support: A causal EMF effect on ASFR — mobile subscriptions are a timing proxy, not a dose

claims.falsification_condition: The age and cohort contrast disappears when adoption timing is replaced by a matched placebo series or when development, policy and tempo covariates are included.

en.text: TFR decline decomposes multiplicatively into sperm, oocyte, timing and motivation factors, so pronatalist policy that only addresses motivation cannot restore replacement: raising one factor while the others fall leaves the product below replacement level.

fi.text: TFR:n lasku hajoaa multiplikatiivisesti siittiö-, munasolu-, ajoitus- ja motivaatiotekijöihin, joten pelkkään motivaatioon kohdistuva pronatalistinen politiikka ei palauta uusiutumistasoa: yhden tekijän nostaminen muiden laskiessa jättää tulon uusiutumistason alle.

supports: Policy evaluation must state which factor in the product an instrument acts on
does_not_support: A quantitative share attributable to each factor

claims.falsification_condition: A population with unchanged biological factors restores replacement-level TFR through motivation-directed policy alone.

en.text: BioCap, the weighted eight-biomarker composite, is the biological input to TFR: it enters the fertility calculation as Level 1 capacity, and behavioural and cultural terms act on that capacity multiplicatively rather than replacing it.

fi.text: BioCap, painotettu kahdeksan biomarkkerin yhdistelmä, on TFR:n biologinen panos: se syötetään hedelmällisyyslaskentaan tason 1 kapasiteettina, ja käyttäytymis- ja kulttuuritermit vaikuttavat siihen multiplikatiivisesti eivätkä korvaa sitä.

supports: The biomarker composite is the measurement interface between biology and the demographic model
does_not_support: The specific biomarker weights — those are diagnostic, not calibrated

claims.falsification_condition: A country's TFR trajectory is reproduced by behavioural and cultural terms alone, with the eight-biomarker composite adding no explanatory value.

en.text: Pairing probability declines multiplicatively when male approach behaviour (testosterone) and female receptivity (oxytocin) both decline: couple formation is a product of the two, so a joint decline reduces pairing faster than either factor alone.

fi.text: Parinmuodostuksen todennäköisyys laskee multiplikatiivisesti, kun sekä miehen lähestymiskäyttäytyminen (testosteroni) että naisen vastaanottavuus (oksitosiini) heikkenevät: parinmuodostus on näiden tulo, joten yhtäaikainen lasku vähentää parinmuodostusta nopeammin kuin kumpikaan tekijä yksin.

supports: Couple formation is modelled before conception, as its own multiplicative stage
does_not_support: A measured partnering-rate effect size for either hormone

claims.falsification_condition: Partnering rates track a single hormonal factor with no interaction term in cohorts where both factors decline.

en.text: Family-formation demand and biological capacity are separately measurable inputs to age-specific fertility: demand-directed instruments move the demand term only, and their effect ceiling is set by the capacity term they cannot reach.

fi.text: Perheenmuodostuksen kysyntä ja biologinen kapasiteetti ovat erikseen mitattavia ikäkohtaisen hedelmällisyyden panoksia: kysyntään kohdistuvat välineet liikuttavat vain kysyntätermiä, ja niiden vaikutuskaton asettaa kapasiteettitermi, johon ne eivät ylety.

supports: Demand and capacity are estimated separately before attributing an observed change
does_not_support: A claim that demand-directed policy has no effect

claims.falsification_condition: Demand-directed policy raises age-specific fertility beyond the ceiling implied by independently measured biological capacity.

en.text: BERM proposes that measured endocrine, receptor-use, circadian and neural states can shift the population distribution of motivation, threat weighting, bonding and effort without every individual changing identically.

fi.text: BERM ehdottaa, että mitatut endokriiniset, reseptorinkäyttöön liittyvät, vuorokausirytmiset ja neuraaliset tilat voivat siirtää motivaation, uhkapainotuksen, kiintymyksen ja ponnistelun populaatiojakaumaa ilman, että jokainen yksilö muuttuu samoin.

supports: A distributional biology-to-behaviour transition can be tested with joint biomarkers and later behaviour
does_not_support: A deterministic diagnosis from political behaviour to an individual's hormone state
A claim that one hormone explains all political variation

claims.falsification_condition: Preregistered biological states fail to improve out-of-sample prediction of later behavioural weighting after baseline behaviour and socioeconomic variables are controlled.

en.text: Within BERM's three-level architecture, a stated cultural or economic reason can be a sincere downstream measurement of a latent biological-behavioural state. A survey report alone therefore cannot identify whether Level 2 or Level 3 initiated the observed behaviour.

fi.text: BERM:n kolmitasoisessa arkkitehtuurissa ilmoitettu kulttuurinen tai taloudellinen syy voi olla vilpitön alavirran mittaus latentista biologis-behavioraalisesta tilasta. Kyselyraportti ei siksi yksin tunnista, käynnistikö havaitun käyttäytymisen Taso 2 vai Taso 3.

supports: Reported reasons and latent biological state must be measured separately before their causal order is assigned
A longitudinal biomarker-behaviour-report design can discriminate Level 2 from Level 3
does_not_support: Every stated fertility reason is biologically generated
Cultural and economic variables have no independent causal effect
Political behaviour diagnoses an individual's hormone state

claims.falsification_condition: Preregistered biological states add no temporal or out-of-sample information about later behaviour or stated reasons beyond prior reports and socioeconomic variables, and the null result replicates independently.

en.text: Epistapege is BERM's proposed observability transition: when an upstream biological state is absent from the data model, a repeatedly measured downstream narrative can be precise as a report while remaining causally incomplete.

fi.text: Epistapege on BERM:n ehdottama havaittavuussiirtymä: kun biologinen ylävirran tila puuttuu datamallista, toistuvasti mitattu alavirran narratiivi voi olla raporttina tarkka mutta kausaalisesti vajaa.

supports: Latent state and reported reason must be measured separately
Repeated self-report does not by itself establish causal priority
does_not_support: That cultural explanations are false
That the complete BERM civilization route is already observed

claims.falsification_condition: Joint longitudinal measurement shows that the upstream biological state adds no temporal, predictive or intervention information beyond the reported reason.

en.text: BERM predicts that otherwise matched explanations will face different evidential thresholds when one preserves conscious agency and the other assigns part of behaviour to a latent physiological antecedent.

fi.text: BERM ennustaa, että muuten samanlaiset selitykset kohtaavat eri evidenssikynnyksen, kun toinen säilyttää tietoisen toimijuuden ja toinen sijoittaa osan käyttäytymisestä latenttiin fysiologiseen edeltäjään.

supports: A matched-framing experiment with reviewer confidence, sample-size demand and replication requirement as outcomes
does_not_support: A universal conspiracy or intentional suppression
That every institution applies the asymmetry

claims.falsification_condition: Matched abstracts with identical methods and effect sizes receive equivalent evidential demands regardless of biological-versus-cultural causal framing.

description.en: Direct ROS-mediated BERM candidate route: a measured physical field input enters an open endpoint-specific response kernel; BERM then proposes VGCC opening, intracellular Ca²⁺ elevation and mitochondrial ROS that can damage sperm membranes, DNA integrity and motility.
description.fi: BERM:n suora ROS-välitteinen ehdokasreitti: mitattu fysikaalinen kenttäsyöte tulee avoimeen päätepistekohtaiseen vasteytimeen; BERM ehdottaa sen jälkeen VGCC-avautumista, solunsisäisen Ca²⁺:n nousua ja mitokondriaalista ROS:ia, joka voi vaurioittaa siittiökalvoja, DNA-eheyttä ja liikkuvuutta.

sharedAssumptions: VGCC activation is a primary EMF transduction mechanism
routes.independenceNote: Uses Ca²⁺/ROS mechanism exclusively; does not share clockgene or circadian data with RPM route
routes.alternativeCompatibility: Compatible with thermal mechanism at high SAR; dominant at low SAR
routes.discriminatingPower: VGCC-specific blocker experiments can isolate this route from RPM

description.en: Circadian disruption pathway: magnetic field vector modulates cryptochrome radical pairs, altering clock gene expression, suppressing pineal melatonin, disrupting HPG axis timing, and impairing ovulatory synchronization.
description.fi: Sirkadiaaninen häiriöreitti: magneettikentän vektori moduloi kryptokromin radikaalipareja, muuttaen kellogeenien ilmentymistä, supressoiden käpylisäkkeen melatoniinia, häiriten HPG-akselin ajoitusta ja heikentäen ovulaation synkronointia.

sharedAssumptions: Cryptochrome radical-pair mechanism is operative in mammals
routes.independenceNote: Uses magnetic vector/CRY pathway exclusively; does not share VGCC/ROS data with direct-ros route
routes.alternativeCompatibility: Compatible with light-mediated melatonin suppression; distinguishable by magnetic field specificity
routes.discriminatingPower: CRY-knockout experiments can isolate this route from VGCC

description.en: Top-down route: TFR decline is decomposed into biological (fecundability) and behavioral (demand/tempo/ART) components. The biological share is estimated by holding behavioral factors constant.
description.fi: Ylhäältä alas -reitti: TFR:n lasku puretaan biologisiin (hedelmällisyys) ja käyttäytymis- (kysyntä/tempo/ART) komponentteihin. Biologinen osuus arvioidaan pitämällä käyttäytymistekijät vakioina.

sharedAssumptions: Behavioral factors can be held approximately constant across comparison cohorts
routes.alternativeCompatibility: Does not distinguish between EMF and other biological causes of fecundability decline
routes.discriminatingPower: Requires cohort comparison stratified by FieldState-compatible physical measurements and a preregistered BERM exposure mapping to isolate an EMF contribution
